arguments.value: Aduro Biotech hired IREYA B.V. as an independent consultant starting July 1, 2020 through December 31, 2020 unless extended or ended earlier. The consultant will advise Aduro on research, clinical development, and other business matters. Aduro will pay €500 per hour, plus approved expenses, with monthly invoices due and payment within 30 days if not disputed. The consultant cannot spend over €5,000 on a single expense or €20,000 total without written approval. The consultant must keep Aduro’s confidential information secret, use it only for the work, and return or destroy it when the agreement ends, while whistleblower protections still apply. Any work product created under the agreement belongs to Aduro, and the consultant assigns related rights to Aduro and must help secure them. The consultant also agrees not to solicit Aduro employees or contractors during the agreement and for 12 months after it ends. The consultant must perform professionally, follow the law, avoid conflicts of interest, and comply with insider-trading rules. California law governs the agreement, which can only be changed in writing signed by both parties.
